Round 2 concept re-review after F-001 fix (d7b106e). The fix is a real correctness fix, not arbitrary optimization: the old flow realpathed only the metadata root (canonicalFsPath skips realpath for missing paths), so a missing-but-contained target under a /var root (realpath /private/var) was misreported as an unsafe-path escape. New ordering — lexical containment (rejects ../ escapes and the root itself) → existence check → canonical realpath containment for existing targets — preserves symlink-escape rejection while restoring the correct target-does-not-exist error; dangling symlinks deterministically report does-not-exist. Repair UX remains explicit and deterministic: --set-git-root required and never guessed, --confirm gates any write, preview prints the exact confirm command and mutates nothing. No auto host repair: doctor is readOnly diagnostics, single-candidate is operator-suggestion-only, ambiguous layouts fail closed with no suggested target or repair command. Command policy marks repair as mainSharedMutating metadata-write and never an automatic resolver input. Smoke test now passes repairable.root uncanonicalized so the /var path is genuinely exercised. No blocking issues.
